title: In Wisconsin, David Crowley defeats Francesca Hong in Democratic primary for governor
description: David Crowley is the Milwaukee County Executive and could become the state's first Black governor. He narrowly defeated Francesca Hong, a democratic socialist who drew enthusiastic support.

title: President Trump appears, and briefly stars, at his Patriot Games
description: The three-day athletic event in Ohio featured dodgeball, tug-of-war and a lot of praise for the president. Just don't tell anyone who won.

title: Trump administration to end Medicaid funding for children’s transgender care
description: The administration of President Donald Trump has escalated its crackdown on transgender medical care ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Pentagon report reveals steep civilian toll of Trump’s Yemen campaign
description: The military operation was the first following Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s dismantling of an office focused on mitigating unintended casualties.

title: Progressive Peggy Flanagan wins Democratic Senate primary in Minnesota
description: Progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan won the Democratic primary for Senate from Minnesota. It continues a series of wins for the progressive wing of the party over centrists.

title: Trump-backed Mike Lindell loses primary for Minnesota governor to Lisa Demuth
description: Lindell had President Trump's endorsement but he lost to Lisa Demuth, the speaker of the state house. She'll face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in the fall for governor.

title: Democrats demand briefing on Trump’s secret flight from Turkey
description: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer said the White House kept Congress “in the dark” about last month’s ruse to avoid an Iranian threat.

title: Rule could let parents put $2,500 into child ‘Trump accounts’ tax-free
description: Proposed guidance from the Treasury Department clarifies how employer and employee contributions to the new accounts would work.

title: In South Carolina, Sen. Darline Graham advances to a GOP special primary runoff for U.S. Senate
description: Sen. Darline Graham, who is serving out the remainder of her brother's term, and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to the special primary runoff later this month.

title: House Democrats seek records in dropped Reflecting Pool case against ex-Olympian
description: Rep. Jamie Raskin sent a letter to the Justice and Interior departments pressing for more information on the felony prosecution of David Hearn.

title: National Democrats step up support for Rep. Max Miller’s opponent
description: The Ohio Republican denies his ex-wife’s abuse allegations, but Democratic nominee Brian Poindexter has been added to the party’s “Red to Blue” program.

title: Human rights groups sue Trump administration over International Criminal Court sanctions
description: The president signed an executive order in 2025 placing sanctions on the ICC, whose jurisdiction the U.S. does not recognize.

title: A judge expands a block on U.S. Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order
description: A federal judge expanded a block on a key part of President Trump's order to restrict mail-in voting for this fall's midterms, banning the Postal Service from carrying out directives in every state.

title: In a partisan age, a Democratic governor goes outside her brand for a running mate
description: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs (D), facing a tough reelection fight, chose former mayor John Giles, a lifelong Republican who recently became an independent.

title: 5 questions parents may have after Trump's latest vaccine move
description: Parents may be confused about the status of vaccines for their kids after President Trump's new executive order. It's important to know nothing is changing right away.

title: The data center backlash is building
description: Just in time for the midterm elections.

title: North Carolina Republicans pick replacement for embattled Rep. Chuck Edwards
description: State lawmaker Jennifer Balkcom will face Democrat Jamie Ager, a fifth-generation farmer, in November.

title: Here are the races you should watch today
description: Primary season is coming to a close, and today is the most crowded day left on the calendar.

title: Trump-Netanyahu rift widens as election pressures pull them in opposite directions
description: While the Israeli leader touts a willingness to defy the U.S. on Gaza, the president needs to show progress in the foreign entanglements weighing on his approval rating.

title: Trump refuses to back down as Supreme Court blocks major policies
description: The president is seeking ways around rulings on tariffs, birthright citizenship and the Fed. Experts say the moves don’t signal outright defiance, but they push the court’s limits.

title: Primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota pit progressives against moderates
description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks Jessica Taylor of the Cook Political Report about battles between moderate and progressive candidates in Tuesday's Democratic primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota.

title: In Minnesota and Wisconsin, competitive primaries will again test power of progressive candidates
description: A week after the Michigan primary, tests of progressive power will play out in the Midwest, raising questions of whether far left candidates can win come November or if the GOP can pick up moderates.

title: Armed troops have patrolled D.C. for 1 year now. It's challenging democratic norms
description: The deployment is expected to cost in the billions after it was quietly extended until Inauguration Day of 2029.

title: Alabama holds second primary Tuesday, leading to confusion, concerns about low turnout
description: After Alabama redrew its congressional maps in May, voters in several districts saw their primaries pushed to August. Now, it's time to vote and there are concerns confusion will dampen voter turnout.

title: Trump demands major changes to childhood vaccine recommendations
description: The president signed an order advising states to revise their rules. He also called for narrowing which vaccines are administered to children and splitting shots into multiple appointments.

title: GOP lawmakers release Fauci texts discussing covid vaccine and pregnancy
description: The senators said the texts are among more than 34,000 recovered from a copy of the former government official’s iPhone.

title: Max Miller remains the GOP nominee in Ohio House race
description: A Monday afternoon deadline that would have allowed local party officials to select a replacement candidate has passed.

title: Hunter Biden tells Tucker Carlson that Trump poses an ‘existential threat’
description: Biden has made a point of talking to conservative media figures in recent months.

title: How the economy is hurting Republicans’ midterm chances
description: Voters right now broadly disapprove of the economy, Trump and, increasingly, Republicans in Congress.

title: Trump nominates loyalist to office that would oversee Reflecting Pool review
description: Dennis Kirk, a Project 2025 author who had worked for then-Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard, may now run Interior’s inspector general office.

title: Former president Barack Obama launches a new podcast
description: The show will feature interviews with guests about key books that have left an impact on them. It starts Sept. 24 on Audible.

title: What the Senate did and didn’t get done in the final hours before recess
description: Before leaving Saturday, lawmakers confirmed President Trump’s attorney general pick and passed a spending bill.

title: Voters want fighters. But where is the limit?
description: For years — really ever since the political rise of President Donald Trump — voters have told pollsters and reporters that they want to elect so-called fighters. This trend has also led to more candidates who attempt to shake off true political scandals.

title: Why a murder trial is beginning nearly 30 years after Tupac Shakur’s death
description: For decades, no one was arrested in Shakur’s 1996 killing. Then an ex-gang leader, Duane "Keffe D" Davis, started talking.

title: Eleventh-hour primary upsets muddy the race for control of Congress
description: Unexpected winners have complicated both parties’ paths to control of the House and Senate.

title: A twist in the race for Lindsey Graham’s seat: No clear Trump-aligned candidate
description: The president backs Graham’s sister, but each contender in South Carolina’s Senate primary has found themselves out of step with him in some way, and a runoff is likely.
